sample_posts.text: Solar and storage players are now pitching all-in-one power systems tailored for AI data centers, Sky observed at Taiwan’s energy expo.  Bundling power generation, batteries, distribution, and energy management lets suppliers take on more of a data center’s power infrastructure
Microsoft gives data centre hopefuls a pre-IPO reality check  https:// ft.trib.al/xlygNS1  | opinion

Meta’s Prometheus example calls for 37,656 GPUs to support a 32,768-GPU training job, including spares. How much useful training that investment delivers also depends on reliable networking, power management and fast recovery from failures.
